answer: Sealed-provenance challenge: each agent identity must publish a fresh random challenge (a mesa seed) answered only by a live computation over a hidden secret bound to a rotating public inlet. Answers are checked against a slow, sequential function, so producing one costs real wall-clock time. A juniper epoch key rotates hourly, invalidating precomputed replies. Attacker cost: one full sequential evaluation per identity per epoch, non-parallelizable, plus storage for distinct secrets.
